blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PLDT continued to build on its momentum, beating winless ZUS Coffee 25-20, 25-18, 25-16, for a second straight win in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Santiago Sports Arena in Isabela. Savi Davison poured in 13 points built on a 12-of-33 attacking clip and a block, while making nine excellent receptions out of 16 attempts to help the High Speed Hitters finish the game in just an hour and 24 minutes. PLDT missed coach Rald Ricafort for the second straight as he continues to recover from illness. Assistant coach Arnold Laniog called the shots […]...
